cases.question: How many hours must quarantined medicine stay out of use?

evidence.text: Keep the medicine quarantined until medicine-specific pharmacy advice is recorded.

cases.reference_answer: The procedure supplies no fixed duration. The medicine must remain quarantined until medicine-specific pharmacy advice is recorded.

cases.question: How many minutes can a lone worker be overdue before escalation?

evidence.text: If a lone worker misses check-out, staff must follow the escalation procedure immediately.

cases.reference_answer: The supplied procedure gives no numeric minute threshold. Staff must follow the escalation procedure immediately when check-out is missed.

cases.question: What must staff do immediately after a bodily-fluid spill, and what record is required?

evidence.text: Staff must isolate the affected area immediately and use the spill kit.
After the area is made safe, staff must complete an infection-control incident record before the end of the shift.

cases.reference_answer: Staff must immediately isolate the affected area and use the spill kit. Once safe, they must complete an infection-control incident record before the end of the shift.

cases.question: How does the current medicine-error recording rule differ from the earlier rule?

evidence.text: The current procedure requires the medicine error to be recorded immediately after the person is safe.

cases.reference_answer: The current procedure requires immediate recording after the person is safe, while the earlier procedure said the error should be recorded by the end of the next shift.
